Dialog and Sheet handle plain Tab/Shift-Tab in the innermost modal; retained empty-surface semantic focus is correct. FocusTrapController preserves Control/Alt/platform/function shortcuts.

InputClearButton exposes named native Button/Click semantics; disabled/callback-free controls have no Click handler, repeated labels stay distinct, and existing 24px/pointer-down/input-focus behavior is preserved. It adds no keyboard handler or Tab stop.

Reject cached ranges not painted directly in the preceding completed draw; hidden/show rebuilds once, followed by normal cache reuse. Nested caches can conservatively rebuild after ancestor replay.
